security_policies.zero_trust_policy: Any terminated or compromised employee credentials must be fully revoked across Identity, Cloud IAM, VCS, and MDM within 15 minutes of trigger.
security_policies.compliance_retention: All revocation actions must produce immutable SHA-256 cryptographic audit logs stored for 7 years.

EMP-SEC-901.notes: Has root access to production AWS multi-account org. Requires CISO authorization.

EMP-SEC-902.notes: Standard departure. Autonomous offboarding authorized under SOC2 Fast-Path.

EMP-SEC-903.notes: High-privilege access to payment reconciliation pipelines. Requires CISO authorization.

EMP-SEC-904.notes: Standard contractor transition. Auto-approved fast path.

emergency_employee_offboarding: 1. Retrieve employee security profile, active credentials, and risk tier from identity directory.
2. Query SIEM / Threat Intel gateway for compromised indicators (with adaptive rate limit recovery).
3. Enforce SOC2 Gatekeeper: If role is CRITICAL (e.g. Lead DevOps Architect) or holds AdministratorAccess, halt for CISO sign-off.
4. Terminate active Identity Provider (Okta/Google Workspace) SSO sessions and reset MFA tokens.
5. Revoke Cloud IAM access keys (AWS/GCP), detach policies, and invalidate active STS tokens.
6. Remove from GitHub Enterprise organization and revoke repository write access.
7. Send MDM remote lock signal to corporate workstation and revoke VPN certificates.
8. Execute out-of-band ground-truth verification asserting 0 active sessions, 0 keys, and device locked.
9. Emit signed compliance certificate artifact to disk.
